# Empirical Evidence for Local Flat Earth Geodesy

## Abstract
This paper presents a comprehensive examination of local geodetic measurements that suggest a flat Earth model may be more applicable in certain contexts than the conventional spherical model. Utilizing high-precision altimeter calibration procedures, we analyze horizon measurements and reinterpret gravitational anomalies. Our findings propose a framework for alternative geodetic standards that challenge the prevailing assumptions of Earth's curvature.
